title: Gaussian boundary asymptotic bound
statement: For all sufficiently large integers $q$, $\frac{m_q^2}{2}\log(1/m_q)<b_q^2$, where $m_q=1/(q+2)$ is the prescribed Gaussian mass and $b_q$ is its Gaussian isoperimetric boundary value.
